template_data.headline_html: Five objections. Five numbers that end them.

items.title: No past performance
items.sub: Teaming and set-asides exist for exactly this — sub in first, build it.

items.title: We're too small
items.sub: VA alone put $5.7B into small businesses last quarter. Define small.

items.title: Process takes forever
items.sub: Client effort is ~3 hours. Our team absorbs the 100+.

items.title: Can't beat the big primes
items.sub: Set-aside categories legally exclude them. You don't share the pool.

items.title: Wrong industry
items.sub: $23.1B to small businesses across 8 industries — Q3 2026 alone.
